Dev sales: spending, disclosure & buyer impact

When does earning from a token become a problem for buyers?

101C · Dev & Supply

Earning is not automatically abuse

A creator may fund work through disclosed fees or token sales. Check quantity, timing, depth, disclosure, and evidence of spending. Compare promises with actual delivery.

For this course, alignment means the records show work and participation supporting each other. Divergence means their interests or activity are moving apart. Destructive distribution describes sales that repeatedly overwhelm buying or involve supported evidence of concealment. Record the observable behavior before assigning a motive.

SituationWhat to checkPossible conclusion
Disclosed limited salesQuantity, depth, bill, deliverySpending may be supported; remaining supply still matters
Repeated promotion with salesWallet links, quantities, claims, subsequent workInvestigate recurring distribution and disclosures
Work continues but buyers leaveReleases, buyer activity, liquidityDemand may be weakening despite delivery
Fees claimed, tokens retainedRecipients, claims, all known sale routesRecord fee income and check token holdings separately

How to investigate it

Compare multiple equal event windows. Record group inventory, sales, earnings, liquidity, announced work, delivery, and traceable payments. Compare sale quantities with current buying and size-specific quotes. A treasury transfer leaves the expense question open until the payment and its purpose can be supported.

Practical case — illustrative

SAMPLE discloses the 5m sale from Chapter 9 as funding a service bill. A payment record and delivered work support part of the stated spending. The later 1m buy leaves 8m available group units. Record that disclosure, the bill, and delivery without treating them as clearance for tomorrow's unlock.

If new evidence instead shows undisclosed related wallets selling while the dev claims no sales, record the contradictory transactions and investigate the disclosure. Keep any uncertain identity links qualified.

What does the result mean?

Update the buying case and supply checks separately. Record which fact changed and what evidence would change your conclusion again. A team can deliver work while buyer demand or trading conditions deteriorate.

Keep this record

Add a spending/disclosure table to the timeline: statement, actual sale/payment, amount, evidence of use, delivery, and unresolved differences.

Add this chapter's findings to your review worksheet →

Check your understanding — answered

The dev sold. Was it malicious? Check amounts, disclosure, depth, related wallets, and use of proceeds before interpreting the pattern.

Funds went to treasury. Is reinvestment established? Look for the subsequent payment and evidence of its purpose.

Price rose during sales. Are incentives healthy? Review the quantities, remaining holdings, control, and buyer persistence.

SAMPLE is made up for this course. For a real token, use current transaction records and platform rules. Inspect shows sampled trades; use external records to check ownership and permissions.
